points.question: Does the company have a brand name product or service that gives it a competitive advantage? As in the world of products, the frequency of the consumer's need differentiates the quality of the competitive advantage.

If they are building cars or designing software, they may not have to buy big expensive jets, or can use the same equipment for twenty years without any risk of obsolescence. If the answer is yes, be careful.

If the treasuries look juicier, the stock might be overpriced.

points.title: Projected annual compounding return as an equity/bond (Book Value model)
points.question: What is the company's projected annual compounding return as an equity/bond? Take the company's average per share return on equity for the last ten years and subtract the average percentage that is not retained and is paid out as a dividend.
